title: Working on a map 👀
content: Anybody been to any of these places?? 1. Usually on a snowmobile in the middle of nowhere being chased by bears. Always night. Log cabin then a gas station like half a mile away. 2. I can't quite get this one right, they are stairs leading to an abandoned parking lot, and the abandoned Semi feels important. On the other side of that is like a sewer venue or something? 3. Giant combined tree house. Combined by stairs, always night. Convenience store in the middle? 4. Grey Town, this one didn't work as well either but it's like a giant grey castle and a bridge to the right with a giant waterfall and water on both sides. 5. A little village, I come in through a bridge, and go down some sketchy concrete stairs and they're are 4 shops in front of me, if I went left, there would be the carnival maybe? 6. Hyper futuristic city/ super huge colorful buildings, looks like it could take place in Japan, I have been here during the day and night. Restaurants, Bars, I think there's always events happening, might also be by carnival, I know the pirate ship is there (The Theme Park one)
